title: The Great Devolvement
causes: Severe climate cooling fracturing the ancient deciduous canopy of southern Jambhudweepa
The drying of the Nilgiri canopy forcing the Vanaras onto the open savanna
outcomes: Loss of higher fire-mastery and tool use in the majority of the Vanara populations
Survival of regressed Vanara descendants as modern monkeys and reclusive outliers
The migration of the solar-guided tribes to the central plains under Lionman's pathfinding
summary: As global climate shifts fracture the southern tree-cities of the Nilgiri Canopy, the hyper-intelligent Vanara civilization begins to collapse and devolve. The sun-spirit Lionman manifests to guide the scattered, regressed tribes safely across the savanna.
sources: Ancient Palm-Leaf Manuscripts of Narmada University
